reason: Both are complete and usable, but Output 1 sizes every test on orders per session with fully verified arithmetic (its 10%/8% sample-size sums, ceilings and profit-at-stake all check out) and sets a stronger shipping bar, while Output 2's faster proxy-metric plan, slightly optimistic 11.9% MDE, 'orders not lower' ship rule and pincode-dependent COD badge inside a 2×2 leave small but real holes.
